}}'''Jesain''' is a [[Wise One]] of the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jesain}}

==Appearance==
She is very short for an Aiel, with a height of 5'2" or 157 cm. She has a great mass of fiery red hair and a temper to match.

==History==
She can [[channel]] the [[One Power]].

==Activities==
She is one of the Wise Ones that [[Travel]]s with [[Sevanna]]'s group to [[Ghealdan]].

[[Faile]] witnesses her and two other Wise Ones, [[Someryn]] and [[Alarys]], stare in a northwesterly direction while she is in [[Malden]]. They can sense the use of the [[Choedan Kal]] at the [[Cleansing of saidin|cleansing of ''saidin'']]. Jesain slaps anyone who gets in her way.
